items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And this other fellow, Benny James, was on the job, and ...(?)... So we go over there together, to the job.

ctx.x: On the banjo? That's Benny James.
That's Benny James? Oh yeah. Yeah. Now I recognize him. Yeah, I thought that was a trombone he had there. That's a banjo. Harry White.
